Real imagery as centerpiece; asymmetric/editorial layouts (NOT centered-stack); animated "live" elements; a compact 5-star review element where it fits; buying-psychology focus; LESS text, MORE presentation. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; mobile-responsive (390w). FORBIDDEN (rejected "AI slop"): centered-stack + particle-canvas + 3-up-grid skeleton; fake globes; dead-space cards; walls of text. Real game art lives in `public/games/art/<slug>_hero.jpg`/`_poster.jpg` (map: `GAME_ART_SLUG` in lib/games.ts).

**Template 1 — Blog post / listicle (`/preview/blog-post`, new component under `components/marketing/blogtemplate/`):** target the two formats Nxeon actually writes — "Best [game] mods for 2026" listicles and "how to host / how much RAM" guides. Design a genuinely beautiful editorial ARTICLE, NOT the current basic one. Include: a game-art banner hero with title + eyebrow + author/date + reading-time; a **sticky table-of-contents / scroll-progress spine**; a **"quick answer" summary box up top** (for AI-citation/GEO — a direct 2-sentence answer + key facts); the listicle body as **beautifully styled numbered item cards** (icon/thumbnail + name + a short "why" — NOT text walls); at least one **inline comparison/spec table** (e.g. a mod feature table or a player-count→RAM table); a pull-quote; a mid-article and end **"Deploy a [game] server in 47 seconds" CTA rail**; and a related-posts strip. Use real sample content for a real game (e.g. a "Best Rust Server Plugins for 2026" article) so it reads true.

**Template 2 — Game mods page (`/preview/mods`, new component under `components/marketing/modstemplate/`):** IMPORTANT honesty constraint from memory — Nxeon has **no fake one-click mod installer**; it sells real **file/SFTP/panel access** to install mods yourself. Keep the honest positioning (real access, not a magic installer) but make it look premium.

**Constraints:** NET-NEW files only; do NOT touch existing live pages/components/MarketingHeader (you may READ the mods page for reference). You MAY append scoped `pv-*` CSS to globals.css (re-read first; concurrent agents appending). `npx tsc --noEmit` clean. Do NOT run `npm run build`. Screenshots best-effort: `PORT=3779 npm run dev` + Playwright, desktop 1440 + mobile 390, save to `/opt/nxeon-staging/.design-previews/` (`blog-*.png`, `mods-*.png`); if dev-server conflict, skip + note it. Shut down after.

Report: both routes, sample content used, screenshot paths (or skipped), and any render issues.
